title: IsFileOp helper + Agent loop ExecutionEnvironment migration
description:
Two prerequisites for remote providers:

1. Implement IsFileOp() helper in internal/sandbox/environment/classify.go — routes file ops vs command ops, needed by all remote providers.

2. Agent loop migration (Plan 11.add01 Phase 4) — wire internal/agent to use ExecutionEnvironment interface instead of old ToolBackend. Old interfaces are already removed, but the agent loop hasn't been connected to the new interface yet.

Include unit tests for both.

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add01.md §4, §5.1
